Largest raw gains were "overeaters help" +15.0 (38.0 to 23.0) and "holistic approach to weight loss" +15.0 (45.0 to 30.0), but both sit on 1-2 impressions and are directional only.

The hydration blog post (/healthy-living-2/why-hydration-is-essential-for-weight-loss-and-management/) is the site's visibility engine: 7,433 impressions and 25 clicks at avg position 7.3 over the 7-day window - more impressions than every other page combined. The sleep-and-metabolism post (2,078 impressions, position 15.0) and the GLP-1 medications post (575 impressions, position 9.8) are the next two.
needs_attention: Keyword coverage: 17 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show GSC impressions; 66 show none. This is a KEYWORD count, not a page count and not a count of unpublished pages. The 83 keywords map to only 50 distinct target pages, 49 of which already point at live www URLs. Most 'no data' keywords are simply long-tail terms with no impressions in a 7-day window.

Near-zero CTR is the biggest gap. Page-level GSC for 2026-08-06 to 2026-08-13 shows 13,410 impressions and 39 clicks sitewide - about 0.29%. The hydration post alone converts 25 clicks on 7,433 impressions (0.34%) despite ranking at position 7.3. Every one of the 17 tracked commercial terms shows 0 clicks this window.

Visibility drift over the full snapshot range is negative on the query dimension: 2,447 impressions at avg position 14.87 on 2026-05-07 versus 1,585 impressions at avg position 19.77 on 2026-08-13. Both figures are query-dimension pulls capped at 500 rows, so the position move partly reflects a wider tail of ranked queries; treat as directional, not as a clean decline. Note also that summary.total_clicks (9) sums the query dimension and undercounts - the page dimension (39 clicks) is the true total.

Slipped terms with real impressions: "san antonio bariatric center" -2.2 (16.8 to 19.0, 6 impressions), "eating disorder counseling san antonio" -0.3 (15.9 to 16.2, 12 impressions), and "bariatric surgery counseling" -0.6 (7.4 to 8.0). Single- and low-impression positions swing day to day; these are watch items, not confirmed losses.

Discovery is finding demand the tracker does not cover: "emotional eating" (75 impressions at position 48.0) and "coping skills for eating disorders" (22 impressions at 28.6) are unclaimed, while the dehydration cluster already ranks 2.3-3.0 on 15-66 impressions each with almost no clicks.
